Centro Iberico.fact: After leaving Chalk Farm in 1976, and moving into a squatted school building in Notting Hill, London, it became a self-managed social centre, venue and studio for the Anarcho-punk scene, surviving into the early 1980s.

Centro Iberico.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Centro Iberico.question: While in Madrid’s _____, Garcia met Stuart Christie, a Scottish anarchist serving time for his part in a plot to assassinate Franco
Centro Iberico.fact: While in Madrid’s Carabanchel Prison, Garcia met Stuart Christie, a Scottish anarchist serving time for his part in a plot to assassinate Franco.

Centro Iberico.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Centro Iberico.question: Pardoned in _____, Christie returned to London where, when he won his own release in 1969, Garcia joined him in the work of the Anarchist Black Cross, an anarchist prisoners’ aid organisation
Centro Iberico.fact: Pardoned in 1967, Christie returned to London where, when he won his own release in 1969, Garcia joined him in the work of the Anarchist Black Cross, an anarchist prisoners’ aid organisation.

Centro Iberico.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Centro Iberico.question: This also accommodated the printing press on which the _____ newsletter and other anarchist material was produced, overseen by Garcia who had been a typesetter at age 13
Centro Iberico.fact: This also accommodated the printing press on which the Black Flag newsletter and other anarchist material was produced, overseen by Garcia who had been a typesetter at age 13. In 1974, meeting in the Centro, the Black Flag Group consisted, in addition to Stuart and Garcia, of Albert Metzler, Ted Kavanagh, Lynn Hudelist, Iris Mills, Graham Rua, Philip Ruff and John Olday (an anarchist artist and performer who led regular cabaret nights).

Centro Iberico.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Centro Iberico.question: According to Ruff, Special Branch "bitterly resented" the failure to convict Stuart Christie in the “Angry Brigade” trial in December _____
Centro Iberico.fact: According to Ruff, Special Branch "bitterly resented" the failure to convict Stuart Christie in the “Angry Brigade” trial in December 1972.

Centro Iberico.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Centro Iberico.question: One of the prisoners for which Garcia, the _____ and Black Flag campaigned for through the Centro was Salvador Puig Antich, a Catalan anarcho-syndicalist
Centro Iberico.fact: One of the prisoners for which Garcia, the Black Cross and Black Flag campaigned for through the Centro was Salvador Puig Antich, a Catalan anarcho-syndicalist.

Centro Iberico.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Centro Iberico.question: Puig Antich, who used call in with Garcia at the Centro in its "early days", had returned to Spain in September _____
Centro Iberico.fact: Puig Antich, who used call in with Garcia at the Centro in its "early days", had returned to Spain in September 1973.

Centro Iberico.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Centro Iberico.question: There, after a series of robberies to fund the _____ (Movimiento Ibérico de Liberación, or MIL), he was arrested for the death of a policeman in a shootout

Centro Iberico.fact: Despite the international outcry, Puig Antich was executed in March 1974.
